title: Minimal surfaces — Question 4.2
exact_target: Determine when a collection of taut foliations can all be made minimal for one metric, allowing an isotopy of each foliation.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300008 (AMR-102-0008). CC BY 4.0.
